headline: The Dutch statutory tariff itself falls by cents at EUR 38,441 and 76,817 (rounded column III), the arbeidskorting never reaches its stated maximum, parents of young children pay no levy up to EUR 30,000, and bunching pay across the end of the arbeidskorting afbouw (EUR 129,077) saves up to EUR 3,540 (single) / 8,234 (single parent) over two years.
